name: Ermenegildo Zegna (ZGN)
teaser: Zegna trades at 9.9 times EBITDA, but after rent and shop investment only 13% of that EBITDA becomes free cash flow. Hold at $13.79, do not add.
llms: Ermenegildo Zegna Group is an Italian luxury menswear company (ZEGNA, Thom Browne, Tom Ford Fashion) valued at 9.9 times 2026E EBITDA before rent, but only about 13% of that EBITDA becomes free cash flow after rent, capital spending and tax. The ten year cash flow model after lease payments gives a Base of $8.40 and the multiple of 2027 EBITDA gives $12.77, a 41% method gap. Bear $6.32, Base $10.15, Bull $13.91. Verdict hold at $13.79, do not add, maximum buy price $5.83.
